title: Helios' Music Discs
body:
Gives all the vanilla Music Discs a refreshed look!

Also changes the music discs of these mods:
- [Biomes O' Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty)
- [Dungeon Now Loading](https://modrinth.com/mod/dungeon-now-loading)
- [Supplementaries](https://modrinth.com/mod/supplementaries)
- [The Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether)
- [The Twilight Forest](https://modrinth.com/mod/the-twilight-forest-unofficial)
- [VinURL](https://modrinth.com/mod/vinurl)
- [Gipples Galore](https://modrinth.com/mod/gipples-galore)
- [Spectrum](https://modrinth.com/mod/spectrum)
- [Companions!](https://modrinth.com/mod/companions-mod)
- [Knight Quest](https://modrinth.com/mod/knight-quest)
- [Brazilian Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/braziliandelight)
- [Aquamirae](https://modrinth.com/mod/aquamirae)

Post-1.20.1 Music Discs enabled by [Vanilla Backport](https://modrinth.com/mod/vanillabackport)
